fail_closed_policy: The host app must hide a card in patient or family mode unless claim text, source, version, review record, expiry policy, locale, and accessibility copy are all approved together.

approval_requirements: Use a current primary guideline, regulator, or peer-reviewed primary source appropriate to the exact claim.
Verify the source URL, title, version, publication date, and applicable population at release time.
Record the exact reviewed claim text, accessible plain-language text, reviewer role, review record, locale, and expiry or re-verification rule.
Separate evidence strength from treatment recommendations and preserve limitations and uncertainty.
Do not copy the reference image's citation or recommendation wording without a fresh source and clinical review.
Never present a generic evidence card as advice for a particular person.
